tool_schemas.name: get_icon_repos
tool_schemas.description: Lists icon repositories (icon sets) stored in Pickapicon, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, exact prefix, and a case-insensitive search over display_name/description; results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and paged using limit with an opaque cursor for the next page. Returns a page of repository records and, when more results exist, a cursor you can pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, out-of-range limit, or unexpected parameters; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to browse repositories.

prefix.description: Filter repositories by exact icon prefix (e.g., "ant-design").

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_icons_by_desc_and_prefix
tool_schemas.description: Searches icons within a single repository prefix where the icon description contains the provided desc substring (LIKE-style match), with optional filtering by status and deprecated, sorted by sort_by/sort_order and paged using limit with an opaque cursor. Returns a page of icon summaries for the requested prefix and a next-page cursor when additional matches are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when prefix/desc are missing or invalid, enums/limit are out of range, or unexpected parameters are supplied; raises NOT_FOUND when the prefix does not correspond to a repository the caller can access; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to search icons.

prefix.description: Icon repository prefix to search within (e.g., "ant-design").

deprecated.description: If provided, filter by whether the icon is deprecated.

limit.description: Maximum number of icons to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_icon_detail_by_prefix_and_name
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single icon’s full detail by repository prefix and icon name, optionally including the SVG asset body when include_svg is true (asset_type currently supports svg only). Returns the icon metadata and, when requested, the svg_body for the selected asset type. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid prefix or name, unsupported asset_type, or unexpected parameters; raises NOT_FOUND when the (prefix, name) icon does not exist or is not accessible to the caller; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to view icon details.

name.description: Icon name within the prefix (the SVG icon name).

include_svg.description: Whether to include SVG asset content (svg_body) in the response.

asset_type.description: Asset type to return for the icon.

tool_schemas.name: get_icon_repo_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single icon repository by id. Returns the repository record when found; raises NOT_FOUND when no repository exists for the id (or is not visible to the caller), and raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids.

include_counts.description: When true, include derived counts such as icon_count (if available) in the response.

tool_schemas.name: get_icon_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single icon metadata record by icon id. Returns the icon record (without assets); raises NOT_FOUND if the icon does not exist or is not visible, and raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids.

include_repo.description: When true, also return the associated repository summary (id, prefix, display_name, status).

tool_schemas.name: get_icon_asset_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single icon asset by asset id. Returns the asset metadata and, when requested, the SVG body; raises NOT_FOUND if the asset does not exist or is not visible, and raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or unsupported asset_type.

include_body.description: Whether to include the asset body content (svg_body) in the response.

tool_schemas.name: create_icon_repository
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new icon repository (icon set). Enforces unique prefix and initializes lifecycle status; refuses requests that violate uniqueness, contain invalid fields, or attempt unsupported status transitions. Returns the created repository record.

prefix.description: Unique icon prefix for the repository (e.g., "ant-design").

homepage_url.description: Public homepage URL for the icon set.

version.description: Version of the icon set (semantic version string when applicable).

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the repository. "deleted" cannot be set on create.

tool_schemas.name: update_icon_repository
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing icon repository by id. Supports metadata edits and lifecycle transitions via status, refusing invalid transitions (e.g., deleted -> anything), and refusing deletion when non-deleted icons still reference the repository unless those icons are deleted first. Returns the updated repository record.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the repository. Allowed transitions: active -> disabled|deleted, disabled -> active|deleted. Deleting may be refused if referenced by non-deleted icons.

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and authorization context derived from the provided credential, including subject, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when no valid credential is provided.

api_key.description: Pickapicon API key used to authenticate this request.

metadata.name: Pickapicon MCP
metadata.description: This backend stores icon repositories (icon sets), the icons within them, and per-icon assets/metadata needed to return detailed icon information by prefix and name. The primary workflows are: list available icon repos, search/browse icons by description/prefix, and fetch a single icon's full detail
